Module Definition Documentation

 module svt_mipi_dsi_device_ppi_hdl ()
Module supporting the PPI Signal Interfaces for the DSI Device. The module defines the Lane 0 as bidirectional and Lane1 to 3 unidirectional interface for reception of the transaction. High Speed Receiver byte clock - For RxByteClkHS signal, the DUT is expected to provide the VIP with an high speed byte clock to allow vip to receive data. All signals RxDataHS, RxValidHS, RxActiveHS and RxSyncHS are driven on on rising edge of RxByteClkHS. Low power Receiver clock RxClkEsc signal is used to generate escape mode sequences. It is a clock for low power data. All signals RxDataEsc, RxValidEsc, RxLpdtEsc, RxUlpsEsc and RxTriggerEsc are driven on rising edge of RxClkEsc.

 module svt_mipi_dsi_host_ppi_hdl ()
Module supporting the PPI Signal Interfaces for the DSI Host. This module defines the Lane 0 as bidirectional and 1 to 3 unidirectional interface for reception of the transaction. High Speed Transmitter byte clock TxByteClkHS signal, the DUT is expected to provide the VIP with an high speed byte clock to allow vip to transmit data. All signals TxDataHS, TxRequestHS and TxReadyHS are driven on rising edge of TxByteClkHS. Low power Transmitter clock TxClkEsc signal is used to generate escape mode sequences. It is a clock for low power data. All signals TxDataEsc, TxValidEsc, TxReadyEsc are driven on rising edge of TxClkEsc .

 host_hdl.forward_packet_ended_cb_exec
 (  svt_mipi_dsi_packet xact  ) 

Callback issued when a transaction has just been completed This callback may be extended to collect functional coverage data, or to check the transaction against a scoreboard, etc.

This method issues the forward_packet_ended callback.

Overriding implementations in extended classes must call the super version of this method.

xact - Reference to the descriptor object of interest.

 host_hdl.post_response_lane_transaction_get_cb_exec
 (  int lane_id , svt_mipi_lane_transaction xact , ref bit drop  ) 

Called after pulling a lane transaction descriptor out of the input port, but before acting on the transaction descriptor in any way.

This method issues the post_response_lane_transaction_get callback.

Overriding implementations in extended classes must call the super version of this method.

lane_id - Used to identify the lane from which the transaction is received.

xact - A reference to the transaction descriptor object of interest.

drop - A ref argument, which if set by the user's callback implementation causes the driver to discard the transaction descriptor without further action.
